data.narrative:
Freenome, a public-stage biotech and health company founded by Gabriel Otte, has raised $1.3B+ and currently carries a $1.1B valuation. The peer universe consists of 3 public comparables in the biotech and health sector: Recursion Pharmaceuticals ($1.6B), Alto Neuroscience ($1.0B), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M).

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach given available data. The median valuation across these three same-sector, same-stage peers is $1.0B, with a range spanning $539M to $1.6B. A public-comp anchoring approach using sector price-to-sales multiples (7.4x median across 3 public tickers: RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) cannot be applied, as Freenome's revenue is not on file—a common constraint for privately-held companies even when publicly traded.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $884M to $1.2B (median $1.0B), with the current $1.1B valuation falling within the upper half of this band and closely aligned with peer medians. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue data, which limits multiples-based validation, and the relatively narrow peer set of three comparables. The range reflects peer-based positioning only; substantive movement would require disclosure of financial performance metrics or material shifts in comparable company valuations.
